gloss: to watch; to view (TV, video, media)

definitions.gloss: to watch; to view; to watch and listen to (TV, video, media)
definitions.explanation: To watch and listen to broadcast or recorded media such as television programs, videos, or online content. Combines seeing ({視|し}) and hearing ({聴|ちょう}).

examples.japanese: ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視聴|しちょう}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一万人|いちまんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{視聴|しちょう}した。
examples.english: Ten thousand people viewed this video.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視聴|しちょう}する⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more people are watching videos on their smartphones rather than on TV.

notes:
Specifically used for watching audiovisual media (TV, video, streaming). Not used for watching sports in person or watching someone do something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{視聴|しちょう}{率|りつ}→視聴率：08381_shichouritsu⟧ — viewership rating
- ⟦{視聴|しちょう}{者|しゃ}→視聴者：02570_shichousha⟧ — viewer, audience
- ⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ — view count (for online videos)
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視聴|しちょう}する — to watch a video
- ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{視聴|しちょう}する — to watch a program

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — the general everyday word for watching/seeing; used in all contexts
- ⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧ — to watch, view (movies, plays, sports); implies appreciation
- ⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to appreciate, enjoy (art, music, film); more about aesthetic enjoyment
